events.title: Upper Roman Nose Lake: Morning Inspection
events.thought: Visited Upper Roman Nose before the descent — steep but navigable, which I consider a useful data point.
events.photoCaption: Upper Roman Nose Lake in Boundary County, Idaho, near the trailhead camp, on a morning visit before the 4K descent.

events.title: Creston Valley Wetlands: Mandatory Slowdown
events.thought: The Creston Valley WMA is exactly the kind of place The Navigator slows everything to 5 mph — I understand, but I have opinions about schedule.
events.photoCaption: Creston Valley Wildlife Management Area, BC, a major wetland complex and migratory bird habitat in the Kootenay Valley.

events.title: Black Salt Cafe, Crawford Bay: Actual Food
events.thought: The Black Salt Cafe in Crawford Bay was an unscheduled but entirely defensible logistics decision.
events.photoCaption: A plated meal at the Black Salt Cafe in Crawford Bay, BC — phyllo pastry roll with roasted beets, a dark rich soup with croutons, herbed tzatziki, and tapenade, served on a white rectangular plate at a red mosaic tile patio table.

events.title: Garland Bay on Kootenay Lake. Back in BC.
events.thought: More northward progress. And finally back in British Columbia. Feels like progress.
events.photoCaption: Waldo at Garland Bay Recreation Site on Kootenay Lake, British Columbia.
photoNote: Drifted down the 4K descent from Roman Nose on empty. Good practice hacking the hybrid battery for distance. Some unexplained noises on 4WD. Its probably fine.
Moved into the smoke. Then moved back out. Ended the day with the back pointed to the sunset.
